rules.name: Galley Mastery
rules.description: Galleys do not have to spend a full Turn without shooting to switch from oars to sails. Decide which movement the ship will use at the start of its activation; use this until the ship's next activation.

rules.name: Meshuda
rules.description: The Meshuda always uses the Advanced Rule Musket Fire.

rules.name: Ra'īs (Captain) Hamidou (rule 1)
rules.description: Hamidou's flagship has the Lucky upgrade at no extra cost.

rules.name: Ra'īs (Captain) Hamidou (rule 2)
rules.description: Hamidou gives any friendly ships currently within 8" of his flagship the Privateer upgrade.
